scope: Integration recommendations, not implemented features or new phase definitions

priorities.build_en: Stable work IDs, persisted status, deduplication, retry and delivery tracking.
priorities.build_zh: 穩定工作 ID、保存進度、去重、重試與送達紀錄。
priorities.tradeoff_en: More foundation work upfront; every trigger reuses it.
priorities.tradeoff_zh: 前期多做基礎控制，後續排程與事件共用。
priorities.acceptance_en: One occurrence produces one result; restart recovers pending work.
priorities.acceptance_zh: 同一事件只產生一份結果；重啟能接回未完成工作。

priorities.build_en: Use OpenClaw-style Heartbeat / Automations to run a bounded Outlook responsibility.
priorities.build_zh: 參考 OpenClaw Heartbeat／Automations，在指定時段查看限定範圍的郵件。
priorities.owner: Polling Scheduler → Runtime Controller → Skills / Tools
priorities.tradeoff_en: Simple rollout, but polling has latency and query/model cost. Bound scope and frequency.
priorities.tradeoff_zh: 容易落地，但有查看間隔與查詢／模型成本；先限制範圍與頻率。
priorities.acceptance_en: Useful mail yields a source-linked reminder; ordinary mail stays quiet.
priorities.acceptance_zh: 重要郵件提醒一次並附原信；一般郵件不打擾。

priorities.title_zh: 需要即時反應，再接事件
priorities.build_en: Use OpenClaw-style HTTP hooks; share the same execution path. Keep low-frequency reconciliation.
priorities.build_zh: 參考 OpenClaw HTTP hooks，共用執行路徑；保留低頻巡查補漏。
priorities.owner: Event Ingress · Subscription Renewal · Runtime Controller
priorities.tradeoff_en: Faster response, but subscriptions, duplicates and missed events need handling.
priorities.tradeoff_zh: 反應更快，但要處理訂閱續期、重送與漏事件。
priorities.acceptance_en: Duplicate delivery starts one task; reconciliation recovers missed items.
priorities.acceptance_zh: 事件重送只啟動一份工作；巡查能找回漏掉的項目。

priorities.title_en: Continue only when work requires it
priorities.title_zh: 長任務需要時，再補續跑
priorities.build_en: Resume on completion; persist goal state and explicit continue / wait / stop rules.
priorities.build_zh: 完成事件接回工作；保存目標，明訂繼續、等待與停止條件。
priorities.owner: Runtime Controller · Colleague State · Engine completion events
priorities.tradeoff_en: Less human prompting, but runaway retries and cost need enforced limits.
priorities.tradeoff_zh: 減少人工催辦，但要限制重試與成本，避免無效續跑。
priorities.acceptance_en: Stop on verified completion or limit; waiting work resumes from its result.
priorities.acceptance_zh: 完成或到達上限即停；等待工作收到結果才接續。

priorities.title_en: Propose new work within a scope
priorities.title_zh: 最後才讓它在職責內找事做
priorities.build_en: Start with bounded maintenance priorities and private proposals; evaluate curriculum only for exploration needs.
priorities.build_zh: 先設定職責與優先順序，產生私人提案；確有探索需求，再評估 curriculum。
priorities.owner: Skills · Request Triage & Priority · Colleague State · Interaction surface
priorities.tradeoff_en: More initiative, but usefulness is harder to verify; collect accept / reject feedback first.
priorities.tradeoff_zh: 自主程度提高，但價值更難驗證；先收集接受／退回回饋。
priorities.acceptance_en: Proposals have evidence, fit the role and respect prior rejection.
priorities.acceptance_zh: 提案有來源、符合職責，也會參考先前退回原因。
